#include<iostream>
#include<cstdio>
using namespace std;

typedef long long llong;

llong n,m,base[20];

llong minimum(llong a,llong b) {return (a<b)?a:b;}

llong solve(llong val,int idx)
{
     if(val<0) val=-val;
     llong quotient=val/base[idx];
     llong result=quotient*idx;
     val=val-quotient*base[idx];
     if(val==0) return result;
     return result+minimum(solve(val,idx-1),idx+solve(base[idx]-val,idx-1));
}

int main()
{
    int i;
    base[1]=1;
    for(i=2;i<=18;i++) base[i]=base[i-1]*10+1;
    cin>>n;
    m=solve(n,17);
    cout<<m;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;

int64 target, answer;
int64 sequence[20];

int64 min_val(int64 x, int64 y) {
    return x < y ? x : y;
}

int64 compute(int64 value, int position) {
    if (value < 0) value = -value;
    int64 count = value / sequence[position];
    int64 contribution = count * position;
    value %= sequence[position];
    if (value == 0) return contribution;
    return contribution + min_val(compute(value, position - 1), 
                                  position + compute(sequence[position] - value, position - 1));
}

int main() {
    sequence[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= 18; ++i) {
        sequence[i] = sequence[i-1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    cin >> target;
    answer = compute(target, 17);
    cout << answer;
    return 0;
}
